agents.enums.isolation.HEAD: not a value: the docs describe worktree isolation in prose that mentions the HEAD commit, and the extractor takes every code span in the cell. agents/field-enums checks isolation directly against "worktree".

agents.enums.model.claude-opus-5: an example full model ID in the description cell, not an alias. artifact.IsValidModelRef already accepts any claude-* ID, so agents/field-enums passes it.

agents.frontmatter.experimental: documented as experimental; DESIGN-0006 records field names only for experimental surfaces. Parse it when a rule needs it (IMPL-0005 OQ4).

hooks.handler_fields.allowedEnvVars: http handler field; no rule reads it. A hooks/http-env-allowlist rule would, and gets its own IMPL (OQ4).
hooks.handler_fields.asyncRewake: command handler field paired with async; hooks/async-rewake has no rule yet (OQ4).
hooks.handler_fields.headers: http handler field; the secret-in-header check that would read it is security rule territory, not yet written (OQ4).
hooks.handler_fields.if: common conditional field; no rule evaluates hook conditions (OQ4).
hooks.handler_fields.input: mcp_tool handler field; no rule validates the tool input shape (OQ4).
hooks.handler_fields.model: prompt and agent handler field; agents/model-policy covers agent frontmatter, not hook handlers (OQ4).
hooks.handler_fields.once: common field; no rule reads it (OQ4).
hooks.handler_fields.statusMessage: common presentation field; no rule reads it (OQ4).

hooks.timeout_defaults.by_event.MessageDisplay: per-event override; hooks/timeout-present cites the per-type default only. Reading overrides needs the event in scope at the message site (OQ4).

plugins.manifest_fields.$schema: editor metadata, not a plugin property; plugin/manifest-fields has nothing to check on it.
plugins.manifest_fields.author: metadata field; no rule consumes it (OQ4). plugin/manifest-fields would parse it when one does.

plugins.manifest_fields.dependencies: component field; a plugin/dependencies-resolvable rule would read it and gets its own IMPL (OQ4).
plugins.manifest_fields.displayName: metadata field; no rule consumes it (OQ4).

plugins.manifest_fields.experimental.themes: experimental surface; field name recorded only, per DESIGN-0006 non-goals.
plugins.manifest_fields.homepage: metadata field; no rule consumes it (OQ4).
plugins.manifest_fields.hooks: component path field; the hook rules lint hooks/hooks.json directly, so the manifest pointer needs no parse (OQ4).
plugins.manifest_fields.keywords: metadata field; no rule consumes it (OQ4).
plugins.manifest_fields.license: metadata field; no rule consumes it (OQ4).
plugins.manifest_fields.lspServers: experimental surface; field name recorded only, per DESIGN-0006 non-goals.
plugins.manifest_fields.mcpServers: component path field; the mcp rules lint .mcp.json and plugin-embedded servers directly (OQ4).
plugins.manifest_fields.outputStyles: component path field; no rule consumes it (OQ4).
plugins.manifest_fields.repository: metadata field; no rule consumes it (OQ4).
plugins.manifest_fields.userConfig: component field; a plugin/user-config-valid rule would read it and gets its own IMPL (OQ4).
plugins.manifest_fields.workflows: component path field; no rule consumes it (OQ4).

skills.frontmatter.arguments: not parsed; no rule consumes it. A skills/arguments-valid rule would, and gets its own IMPL (OQ4).
skills.frontmatter.background: not parsed; no rule consumes it (OQ4).
skills.frontmatter.compatibility: not parsed; portable.limits records its 500-character cap for a future skills/portable-fields rule (OQ4).
skills.frontmatter.effort: not parsed on skills; agents/field-enums covers the agent spelling. Parse it when a skill rule needs it (OQ4).

skills.frontmatter.paths: not parsed; no rule consumes it (IMPL-0004 out of scope, OQ4).
